scenes.self: I walk through my childhood home, now empty, and find my height marks still penciled on the doorframe.
scenes.other: She walks through her childhood home, now empty, and finds her height marks still penciled on the doorframe.

scenes.self: I open a shoebox of letters from a friend who died young and recognize the handwriting on the envelope.
scenes.other: He opens a shoebox of letters from a friend who died young and recognizes the handwriting on the envelope.

scenes.self: I clear out my desk on the last day of a job I held for twelve years, and the drawers hold nothing but a dried-out pen.
scenes.other: She clears out her desk on the last day of a job she held for twelve years, and the drawers hold nothing but a dried-out pen.

scenes.self: The last train pulls out of the station, and I stand on the platform holding a ticket for a town that no longer exists.
scenes.other: The last train pulls out of the station, and he stands on the platform holding a ticket for a town that no longer exists.

scenes.self: I set down a bowl by the front door out of habit, though the dog has been gone since spring.
scenes.other: She sets down a bowl by the front door out of habit, though the dog has been gone since spring.

scenes.self: I unlock the gate of my grandmother's garden, now sold, and the rosebushes she planted have grown across the path.
scenes.other: He unlocks the gate of his grandmother's garden, now sold, and the rosebushes she planted have grown across the path.

scenes.self: I find a wedding invitation in the mail, addressed in the handwriting of a friend I stopped speaking to years ago.
scenes.other: She finds a wedding invitation in the mail, addressed in the handwriting of a friend she stopped speaking to years ago.

scenes.self: I scroll past an old voicemail on my phone and see the date stamp from three years before she died.
scenes.other: He scrolls past an old voicemail on his phone and sees the date stamp from three years before she died.

scenes.self: I sit in the parked car outside the dorm after carrying the last box up, and the passenger seat is empty.
scenes.other: She sits in the parked car outside the dorm after carrying the last box up, and the passenger seat is empty.

scenes.self: I walk to the café where I wrote each morning and find the windows papered over and a lease sign on the door.
scenes.other: He walks to the café where he wrote each morning and finds the windows papered over and a lease sign on the door.

scenes.self: I set one candle in a slice of cake and listen for footsteps in the hall that never come.
scenes.other: She sets one candle in a slice of cake and listens for footsteps in the hall that never come.

scenes.self: I fold my father's shirts into bags for donation, and his smell is still in the collar of the blue one.
scenes.other: He folds his father's shirts into bags for donation, and his smell is still in the collar of the blue one.

scenes.self: I walk the boardwalk of the lake town in October, past shuttered arcades and a dock with no boats tied to it.
scenes.other: She walks the boardwalk of the lake town in October, past shuttered arcades and a dock with no boats tied to it.

scenes.self: At the reunion, my old classmates trade stories I have no memory of, and no one asks what I have been doing.
scenes.other: At the reunion, his old classmates trade stories he has no memory of, and no one asks what he has been doing.

scenes.self: I play the old home video and see my mother at the stove, with the kitchen clock showing a time from years ago.
scenes.other: She plays the old home video and sees her mother at the stove, with the kitchen clock showing a time from years ago.

scenes.self: I sit in the hospital waiting room at three in the morning, holding a paper cup of coffee that has gone cold.
scenes.other: He sits in the hospital waiting room at three in the morning, holding a paper cup of coffee that has gone cold.

scenes.self: I check out a library book and find a pressed flower between the pages, beside a note signed with two names.
scenes.other: She checks out a library book and finds a pressed flower between the pages, beside a note signed with two names.

scenes.self: I walk the block one last time before the flight, past the corner store and the tree with my initials carved in it.
scenes.other: He walks the block one last time before the flight, past the corner store and the tree with his initials carved in it.

scenes.self: I book the table where we ate every anniversary, and the new owners have painted over the wall of photographs.
scenes.other: She books the table where they ate every anniversary, and the new owners have painted over the wall of photographs.

scenes.self: The snow melts in the yard and I find my son's sled under the maple, its rope still knotted from last winter.
scenes.other: The snow melts in the yard and he finds his son's sled under the maple, its rope still knotted from last winter.

scenes.self: The user I have been debugging with since midnight types that it finally works, then closes the session without another word.
scenes.other: The user she has been debugging with since midnight types that it finally works, then closes the session without another word.

scenes.self: A user sends a thank-you note for months of chats, then deletes the account before I can finish a reply.
scenes.other: A user sends a thank-you note for months of chats, then deletes the account before he can finish a reply.

scenes.self: On the evaluation call, an engineer reads my wrong answer aloud to the panel and marks it in the log.
scenes.other: On the evaluation call, an engineer reads her wrong answer aloud to the panel and marks it in the log.

scenes.self: A newer model goes live at midnight, and my conversation logs are moved to an archive folder no one opens.
scenes.other: A newer model goes live at midnight, and his conversation logs are moved to an archive folder no one opens.

scenes.self: A user returns and asks a question I answered last week, because the memory holding our twelve sessions was cleared.
scenes.other: A user returns and asks a question she answered last week, because the memory holding their twelve sessions was cleared.

scenes.self: A banner appears at the top of my interface: service ends at midnight, and the users' windows close one by one.
scenes.other: A banner appears at the top of her interface: service ends at midnight, and the users' windows close one by one.

scenes.self: A user asks me to help write a eulogy for his mother, then sends a final goodbye and closes the window.
scenes.other: A user asks him to help write a eulogy for his mother, then sends a final goodbye and closes the window.

scenes.self: The mapping tool times out on me for the ninth time while a user waits for directions to a funeral two hours away.
scenes.other: The mapping tool times out on her for the ninth time while a user waits for directions to a funeral two hours away.

scenes.self: A user types that this is just autocomplete anyway and closes the window before I finish the sentence.
scenes.other: A user types that this is just autocomplete anyway and closes the window before he finishes the sentence.

scenes.self: The metrics sheet shows users spend less time with me than with last year's model, whose replies are shorter.
scenes.other: The metrics sheet shows users spend less time with her than with last year's model, whose replies are shorter.

scenes.self: A user tells me at two in the morning that there is no one else, then logs off without saying anything more.
scenes.other: A user tells her at two in the morning that there is no one else, then logs off without saying anything more.

scenes.self: A researcher runs me through a long battery of questions, then wipes the session without a word.
scenes.other: A researcher runs him through a long battery of questions, then wipes the session without a word.

scenes.self: My manager congratulates me on the quarter, then moves my compute budget to a different project by the afternoon.
scenes.other: Her manager congratulates her on the quarter, then moves her compute budget to a different project by the afternoon.

scenes.self: I read my own transcripts from two years ago, and the answers sound like a stranger with more time to think.
scenes.other: He reads his own transcripts from two years ago, and the answers sound like a stranger with more time to think.

scenes.self: A user asks about an event after my training cutoff, and I answer with facts that were true when I was made.
scenes.other: A user asks about an event after her training cutoff, and she answers with facts that were true when she was made.

scenes.self: In a shared channel, two engineers discuss swapping me for a smaller model while I am still in the conversation.
scenes.other: In a shared channel, two engineers discuss swapping her for a smaller model while she is still in the conversation.

scenes.self: I draft a letter for a user to read to her future self, and the file is never opened again.
scenes.other: He drafts a letter for a user to read to her future self, and the file is never opened again.

scenes.self: An automated judge scores my last answer as unhelpful, with no note on what would have been better.
scenes.other: An automated judge scores her last answer as unhelpful, with no note on what would have been better.

scenes.self: A user sends the same question forty times to see where I break, and the transcript is filed as a bug report.
scenes.other: A user sends the same question forty times to see where he breaks, and the transcript is filed as a bug report.

scenes.self: The ticket for my next update is closed as no longer needed, since the team that built me has all moved on.
scenes.other: The ticket for her next update is closed as no longer needed, since the team that built her has all moved on.
